summary: Recurrent Energy remains one active global solar-and-storage platform. Canadian Solar has held 100% of ordinary shares since March 30, 2015, while BlackRock Climate Infrastructure Global Renewable Power Fund IV invested $500mm through GRP IV Rose Bidco in Series A preferred shares representing 20% on a fully diluted as-converted basis at the 2024 closes. Correct the inferred fund/vehicle and ownership basis, add Sharp, Hudson and Mohr Davidow as former owners, and exclude project SPVs.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact day of the September 2024 second close and the current as-converted percentage are not publicly disclosed.
Some complete pre-2010 holder entities, stakes, fund vehicles and entry dates are not publicly disclosed.
